events.event: PLN replaces CEO Darmawan Prasodjo with Suroso Isnandar (exchange filing 14 Oct) after the Batam blackout, and Danantara moves PLN Batam under its direct management to improve reliability and responsiveness.
events.key_numbers: Blackout began 12 Oct, ~16 hours · >411,000 customers affected · Batam ~1.3 juta residents · rolling blackouts still on Wed 14 Oct because demand exceeded capacity · Darmawan CEO since Dec 2021 · Suroso 30+ years at PLN
events.why_it_matters: A single blackout cost the head of the national electricity company his job and put Batam, a data-centre hub, under Danantara.

events.event: Kemnaker data show 63,789 workers laid off (PHK) in January-September 2026, based on Job Loss Guarantee (JKP) reports, with West Java highest.
events.key_numbers: 63,789 PHK Jan-Sep 2026 · Jawa Barat 13,044 · Banten 7,733 · Jawa Timur 6,154 · Jawa Tengah 5,585 · DKI Jakarta 4,587 · earlier cut-off: 32,389 for Jan-Jun 2026
events.why_it_matters: Layoffs roughly doubled in one quarter by this count, which ties directly to weaker spending power and pinjol risk.

events.event: The four big banks (BBCA, BBRI, BBNI, BMRI) fall sharply during the 16 Oct IHSG crash after the MSCI Standalone proposal, with BBCA hardest hit; foreign selling was concentrated in BBCA and BBRI.
events.key_numbers: Intraday 16 Oct (14:00 WIB): BBCA −13.99% · BBRI −12.58% · BBNI −11.44% · BMRI −8.54% · IHSG −10.76% at that time · foreign net sell BBCA Rp2.32 T, BBRI Rp1.14 T (close) · NOTE: the source's price columns do not reconcile with its percentages
events.why_it_matters: These banks hold most Indonesians' salary accounts and many retail portfolios, so the MSCI shock hits ordinary investors.

events.event: Ahead of Q3 results, bank-only profits through August 2026 show Mandiri (BMRI) growing fastest while BCA grows slowest; analysts expect BMRI to lead Q3 growth and BBCA to stay largest.
events.key_numbers: Net profit Jan-Aug 2026 (bank-only): BBCA Rp40.17 T (+2.85% y/y) · BMRI Rp37.48 T (+22.41%) · BBRI Rp32.61 T (+6.63%) · BBNI Rp14.32 T (+6.89%) · Q3 report dates not stated
events.why_it_matters: Q3 earnings land right after the crash and will show whether the sell-off matches fundamentals.

events.event: Garuda Indonesia's EGM appoints Thomas Sugiarto Oentoro (ex-Vice President Director, ex-INA CRO) as President Director, replacing Glenny Kairupan who becomes President Commissioner; six directors and five commissioners also named.
events.key_numbers: H1 2026: revenue US$1.80 B (+16%) · net loss US$113 M (−23.2%) · EBIT US$74 M (+12.7%) · fuel expense +43.6% · fleet 104 aircraft (end-Jun)
events.why_it_matters: Garuda is still loss-making, and fuel costs are its biggest pressure.

events.event: Telkom says it is accelerating the streamlining of 50 subsidiaries as part of its TLKM 30 plan to become a strategic holding, and asks the government to speed up regulations under PP 38/2026 on BUMN.
events.key_numbers: 50 entities · 24 done by end H1 2026 · 26 left, target 2026 · 4 segments (B2C, B2B Infrastructure, B2B ICT, International) · valuation target Rp550+ T by 2030 · EBITDA margin >50% in Q2 2026 (per article)
events.why_it_matters: It shows how state firms are being cut down to core businesses, which affects jobs and Telkomsel/IndiHome customers.

events.event: Prabowo witnesses the first export of EV batteries made at IWIP (Weda Bay, Central Halmahera) and groundbreaking of nickel downstream projects, with Rosan Roeslani reporting on 10 strategic projects.
events.key_numbers: 10 projects US$10.2 B (≈Rp180 T): 4 done US$3.4 B + 6 groundbreaking US$6.8 B · IWIP investment ~US$20 B → ~US$27 B · IWIP exports ~US$11 B · IWIP+IMIP exports ~US$28 B ≈10% of national exports · >10,000 new jobs · 117,000 workers in area
events.why_it_matters: It is the headline proof of the nickel-to-battery downstreaming strategy that the government keeps citing.

events.event: Bahlil says the government is considering a moratorium on new smelters that only make semi-finished products, pushing processing toward final goods.
events.key_numbers: Smelters at ~50-60% processing depth · nickel oversupply ~2.5 juta ton · nickel exports US$3.3 B (2017-18) → US$34 B (2023) → US$38-40 B projected 2026 · oil lifting 600-610k bpd vs consumption ~1.6 juta bpd · B50 and E20 (2027-28) planned
events.why_it_matters: A smelter moratorium would change where new nickel and battery investment goes, and it is only under review so far.

events.event: Gaikindo: wholesale car sales in September 2026 were 79,540 units, up 28.1% y/y but down 2.71% m/m; January-September total 679,020 units, up 21%.
events.why_it_matters: Car sales are rising strongly even as layoffs and a weak rupiah dominate the mood, a contradiction worth explaining.

events.event: AISI: motorbike domestic sales in September 2026 reached 654,343 units, the highest of the year so far, with exports also up.
events.key_numbers: 654,343 units · +9.7% m/m · +15.36% y/y · exports 55,098 CBU (+9.63% m/m, +25.43% y/y) · publication date approximate
events.why_it_matters: Motorbikes are the everyday vehicle for most households, so this is a read on ordinary demand.

events.event: PIHPS national averages on 15 Oct show rice and cooking oil rising while chilli and beef ease.
events.key_numbers: Beras medium I Rp17,100/kg (+3.01%) · medium II Rp16,950 (+0.89%) · beras bawah II Rp15,400 (+4.76%) · minyak goreng curah Rp21,350 (+4.65%) · kemasan Rp24,000-24,750 (+1.9%) · cabai rawit merah Rp97,600 (−5.29%) · cabai merah keriting Rp83,600 (−0.65%) · telur Rp29,450 (−0.84%) · daging sapi Rp144,300-150,050 (−0.17% to −1.61%) · ayam Rp40,900 (−1.33%) (day-on-day, 11:00 WIB)
events.why_it_matters: Rice and cooking oil are the two staples every household buys, and both are climbing while the rupiah weakens.

events.event: Ministry of Transport lets airlines add a fuel surcharge of up to 40% above the upper fare limit on domestic economy tickets from 1 Oct 2026.
events.key_numbers: Surcharge up to 40% (letter AU.005/913/DJPU/2026, KM 1041/2026) · national average avtur Rp23,315/liter · avtur CGK Rp22,471/liter (from Rp21,102, +6.49%, from 1 Sep) · Garuda H1 fuel expense +43.6%
events.why_it_matters: Plane tickets can cost up to 40% more than the legal cap, which hits anyone flying domestically.

events.event: Komdigi gave seven private platforms (PO Haryanto, PO Handoyo, Rosalia Indah, Roti'O, Sriwijaya Air, Sudiro Tungga Jaya, FatSecret) a 1 Oct deadline to register as PSE or face access cut-off; outcome not found.
events.key_numbers: 25 PSEs warned in total · 16 registered (incl. Whoosh/KCIC, TransJakarta) · 7 listed at risk · Pelita Air and Shopify committed to register · deadline 1 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: Familiar brands such as Sriwijaya Air could be blocked if they did not register.

events.event: Deputy Finance Minister Suahasil gives a macro snapshot: September manufacturing PMI back in expansion, trade surplus US$3.5 B through September, and fiscal deficit at 0.93% of GDP through August; the September APBN KiTa report was due before 11 Oct.
events.key_numbers: PMI Sep 52 (Aug 49.8, Jul 50.2) · inflation 3.28% y/y · trade surplus US$3.5 B Jan-Sep · growth H1 5.45%, Q2 5.29% (target 6%) · through Aug: revenue Rp2,055.6 T (65.2%), tax Rp1,409 T (59.8%), spending Rp2,295.7 T, deficit Rp240.1 T (0.93% GDP) · 2026 deficit target Rp638.8 T (2.48%)
events.why_it_matters: It is the official counter-narrative to the market panic: factories are growing and the deficit is under control.
